summary: P1 final batch (Orgs+Departments, multi-level approval, EMD w/ Stripe refund, Q&A + Addenda) — 33 new backend tests added under TestV17P1 + 9 baseline TestHealth/TestAuth = 42/42 PASS in 9.34s (serial, -n 0). All P1 UI acceptance criteria verified via Playwright.

issues: Duplicate department names shown when multiple orgs contain a dept with the same name (e.g., two 'Medical Facilities (MED)' entries). Not a P1 breaker but confusing UX — consider showing 'ORG · Dept Name (CODE)' or filter dropdown to only the user's current org.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L627-660 approval chain correctly appends steps in ascending threshold order and only when budget >= threshold (integer & float ok). Both 1-step (budget=50k) and 2-step (budget=200k) chains verified. Under-threshold (budget=5k) creates 0-step chain and opens directly — matches spec.
server.py L710-719 vendor list filter q['status']='open' correctly excludes pending_approval/rejected. Verified: 3 pending_approval tenders created by buyer are absent from vendor GET /api/tenders.

server.py L1240-1268 approve_tender walks chain step-by-step; final approval transitions status='open' AND emits broker.broadcast('tender.created'). Rejection sets status='rejected' immediately (regardless of remaining steps). Flat pending (empty chain) also opens on approve. Verified end-to-end.

server.py L1289-1297 _qa_out anonymization: correctly strips asked_by_user_id + asked_by_name for viewers who are neither buyer/admin nor the author. Author (vA) always sees own identity, buyer sees identity, other vendor (vB) gets stripped. Verified.
server.py L1329-1334 list_questions vendor filter uses $or [{published:True}, {asked_by_user_id:self}] — correctly hides unpublished questions from other vendors. Verified.
server.py L1362-1382 publish_addendum $push addendum with uuid.hex id, title, body, published_at, published_by_name. Vendors with bids get notifications. Verified UI publishes and list renders.
server.py L840-842 EMD requirement gate: if tender.emd_required and neither emd_reference nor emd_payment_intent_id → 400. Verified.
server.py L849 bid.emd_status set to 'held' on creation when emd_required; correctly None otherwise.
server.py L957-963 award_bid EMD side-effects: winner emd_status='held_as_security', losers get 'refundable' (except already refunded/forfeited/refund_pending). Verified via post-award GET /api/bids.

server.py L1386-1422 emd_refund: proper 400 on already refunded, on non-EMD tender; forfeit=true bypasses Stripe call; refund without emd_payment_intent_id skips Stripe (goes to 'refunded' directly). All paths verified.
CreateTender.jsx L392-441 ct-governance panel: ct-department dropdown, ct-require-approval, ct-emd-required present. Toggle ct-emd-required reveals ct-emd-amount + ct-emd-currency. Verified.

TenderDetail.jsx L933-996 approval-panel with approval-chain (ordered list, numeric badges), approval-notes, approve-btn ('Approve · dept_head' label), reject-btn. Panel disappears when final step approves; page shows tender status=open. Verified via UI walk-through of 2-step chain.

TenderDetail.jsx L1043-1112 qa-panel + qa-ask-form (vendor only when open) + qa-question-input + qa-submit-question + qa-item-{id} + UNPUBLISHED pill + qa-answer-input-{id} + qa-answer-submit-{id}. All present and behavior matches spec. Answered questions remove pill and become visible to all vendors.

TenderDetail.jsx L1122-1180 addenda-list, addendum-{id}, addenda-open-btn → addenda-publisher → addenda-title/body/publish-btn. Publisher flow verified: after publish, addenda-list shows entry with title/body/published_by_name/date.

TenderDetail.jsx L429-450 bid-emd-block (visible when tender.emd_required + vendor bid form rendered), bid-emd-reference, bid-emd-pi. Verified for approved vendor on EMD tender. Note: block naturally hidden when vendor is unapproved (whole bid form guard).

Minor UX (non-P1): startup seed re-inserts default departments idempotently by (org_id, code). If admins manually create additional 'Medical Facilities' style depts in other orgs, dropdown displays duplicates — consider a composite label 'Org · Dept' in ct-department option text.

server.py L1013 uses `emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout` correctly; but EMD refund at L1407 uses raw `stripe.Refund.create()` (module-level API key at L79). This is fine and independent of the emergentintegrations flow. Exceptions are caught (L1409-1412) and status is set to 'refund_pending' — good defensive behavior.

Code smell (non-blocking): server.py is now 1665 lines. Approvals + Q&A + Addenda + EMD refund together account for ~260 lines and could be moved to /app/backend/routers/p1.py for maintainability (mirror the two-envelope split you already avoided). Not a bug.
